examples.instruction: Begin at the residential building with a light brown color , which is medium - sized compared to surrounding structures . It features a rectangular shape with symmetrical windows . Then , proceed directly ahead to reach a large , gray skyscraper characterized by modern architecture . Next , make a slight stop and descend to the red - brick apartment building , which has rows of windows and doors outlined by white frames and is of medium size .

Elevate towards the modern skyscraper with a large , curved glass facade in blue . Then , proceed directly ahead to it . Slightly turn left and continue straight towards the blue building characterized by its large size and grid - like pattern of windows . Finally , lightly halt and drop by the tall , modern office building with a curved reflective glass facade , also in blue .
